summary.directAnswer:
Repository: 'Personal external memory service using Vision AI' — an AI-powered personal knowledge management system. Main implementation paths:

1. Backend MCP/FastAPI surface: FastAPI app (main.py) with MCP server (mcp_server.py, app/mcp/server.py) using FastMCP. Provides scoped tools via stdio/HTTP transport, integrated through AuthMiddleware.

2. Frontend auth: Password-based + TOTP 2FA (Login.tsx, api.ts). Uses createSessionWithPassword → completeSessionWith2FA flow with JWT session tokens.

3. Extension capture: Firefox extension (firefox-inbox/background.ts, content/getSelection.ts) captures page URL/title/selected text and submits to backend.

4. Ops scripts: deploy-prx-lxc.sh (system deps, service user, migrations); backup-sqlite.sh (SQLite .backup, age encryption, integrity checks).
